# COAI — Intelligent Business Infrastructure

Chaotically Organized AI, LLC helps contractors and service businesses identify and repair digital and operational gaps in their customer journey.

## Contact
- Phone: (661) 683-0228
- Email: chaoticallyorganizedai@gmail.com
- Service area: Bakersfield and Kern County, California; remote services nationwide
- Website: https://www.chaoticallyorganizedai.com/

## Three solutions
- Digital Diagnostic & Repair: $200 diagnostic; $300 for agreed repairs, $500 total. Includes customer-journey testing, visibility review, prioritized findings and a scoped retest.
- COAI Revenue Engine: $1,997 implementation + $297/month management. Scoped website modernization, lead capture, CRM integration, missed-call recovery, approved follow-up, monitoring and reporting.
- Intelligent Business Infrastructure: from $4,997 implementation + $597–$997/month management. Includes Revenue Engine capabilities and scoped AI reception, routing, integrations and reporting.

Scope, usage limits, third-party costs, ownership and timing are confirmed in writing. Communications features are conditional on consent, applicable registration and technical readiness. No guaranteed revenue, rankings or AI recommendations.
